{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for imbalance
print("Cross-tabulation of channel by customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment']))

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_age to check for imbalance
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel by customer_age (mean):")
print(df.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].mean())

# Check if customer_age is balanced between groups
print("\nCustomer age standard deviation by channel:")
print(df.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].std())"}
